title: Elodie and the Gravity
author: Petra Fairweather
blurb: Odile Delacroix, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
